dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.heroBody: The portal home now uses the same color semantics for production, business, traceability, and alerts, with a cleaner reading aligned with the coffee identity.
dashboard.heroSupport: Reuse these same color families in widgets, tables, chips, and new KPI cards to keep the suite visually consistent, even when the summary is filtered to {period}.
dashboard.periodHint: Change the summary window to compare recent pace against yearly or historical totals.
dashboard.customRangeErrorRequired: Fill in both dates to use a custom range.
dashboard.customRangeErrorOrder: The start date cannot be after the end date.
dashboard.comparisonUnavailableHint: This filter has no equivalent previous period.
dashboard.summaryLoadError: Could not load the operational summary. {reason}
dashboard.focusBody: Separate operations, business, traceability, and risk so each block keeps its own weight without competing for attention.
dashboard.focusProduction: Production: yield, availability, process progress, and usable stock.
dashboard.focusCommercial: Commercial and finance: sales, collections, margin, and delivery commitments.
dashboard.focusTraceability: Traceability and quality: connected lots, complete origin, and document follow-up.
dashboard.guideBody: Baseline rule for future KPI cards, dashboards, and analytical components.
dashboard.guideProductionDescription: Coffee-leaf green for operations, usable inventory, and production fulfillment.
dashboard.guideCommercialDescription: Roasted-coffee brown for customers, sales, invoicing, and business signals.
dashboard.guideFinanceDescription: Harvest gold for margin, targets, comparisons, and highlighted outcomes.
dashboard.guideTraceabilityDescription: Informational teal for origin, follow-up, routes, and operational context.
dashboard.guideRiskDescription: Mustard and terracotta only for warnings, blockers, and real exceptions.
dashboard.statusBody: Chips and alerts use soft backgrounds, dark text, and saturated color only when the message needs higher priority.
dashboard.alertSuccess: Success: confirm availability, correct closures, or process progress without taking over the screen.
dashboard.alertInfo: Information: explain origin, follow-up, integrations, and operational context.
dashboard.alertWarning: Warning: reserve this tone for real risks, not for navigation or primary actions.
dashboard.kpiProductionDescription: Use primary for usable volume, production progress, and operating capacity.
dashboard.kpiCommercialDescription: Use secondary for customer, invoicing, and demand indicators.
dashboard.kpiFinanceDescription: Use the harvest accent to highlight targets, margin, and key comparisons.
dashboard.kpiTraceabilityDescription: Use info for lot follow-up, document quality, and process flows.
